title: Add login endpoint with email + password
body:
## Background
Users need a way to authenticate. Implement `POST /api/auth/login` accepting `{ email, password }` and returning a session JWT.

## Acceptance criteria
- 200 + JWT on valid credentials
- 401 on invalid credentials
- Rate-limit to 5 attempts / minute / IP

title: Add logout endpoint that revokes the JWT
body: Add `POST /api/auth/logout` that adds the current JWT to the revocation list and clears the session cookie.

title: Password reset flow (forgot password)
body:
Implement the forgot-password flow:
- `POST /api/auth/forgot` sends a reset email
- `POST /api/auth/reset` accepts the token + new password

Reset tokens must expire in 1 hour.
